blocks.x:
AN INTERVIEW WITH
MR. GIL EVANS
BY
MRS. ARMSTEAD JOHNSTON
(REELS TWO AND THREE)

A small town, a man walked up and gave me this picture. of us, I was playing at the Village Vanguard and he happened to be there one night. Two years ago I had a one week stand there and he came up with that picture. Can you imagine that?
No, I can't. Was he a Japanese himself?

He was a tourist. Just came over here and was a jazz fan you know. And he was a nice man and he came up, most of them that came to the concert were very young though. They were all under twenty. Some of them were about eleven years old it seemed.
